file_format: one JSON object per line: id, set, split, prompt, answer, aliases, scorer, meta; sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, '\n' line ends
name: musique_ans_dev

prompt_adapter.answer_line: Answer: <the short final answer only: an entity, date, or number>
prompt_adapter.description: MuSiQue-Ans: all context paragraphs in source order, numbered [P1].., then the question.
prompt_adapter.name: musique_ctx

sampling.method: stratified, largest-remainder allocation, lowest sha256(seed|sample|set|id) first

source.note: local copy downloaded by the playground (revision from its HF cache)

split_rule.rule: 80% dev / 20% final; n_final = round_half_up(N/5), apportioned over strata by largest remainder; lowest sha256(seed|split|set|id) in each stratum go to final

tokenizer.counted: Qwen3 chat template, one user message, add_generation_prompt, enable_thinking=True
